detailZones.title: Receiving bay
detailZones.description: Inspect the dock opening, seals, guards, floor transition and arriving trailer.

detailZones.title: Material handling
detailZones.description: Follow the hand truck, pallet jack, wrapped load, floor scale and their visible parts.

detailZones.title: Pallet racking
detailZones.description: Inspect rack structure, pick slots, plain cartons, pallets and reusable grocery crates.

detailZones.title: Cold storage
detailZones.description: Explore the walk-in cooler opening, strip curtain, evaporator, shelves and freezer-door hardware.

detailZones.title: Packing station
detailZones.description: Inspect the stainless bench, open carton, tape gun, clipboard, printer and film roll.

detailZones.title: Sanitation and utilities
detailZones.description: Follow the mop sink, tool rack, floor drain, lighting, sprinkler pipe, duct and conduit.

anchorAudit.rationale: The generated source and 1600×900 final photograph were inspected at native pixels. The scene retains only independently pointable receiving, handling, rack, cold-room, packing, sanitation and building-service objects or parts. Text, brands, temperatures, safety status and work-process claims are excluded.
